description: Changes the status of a user's community entry and returns it; the author is notified live, with your reason and message. approve: pending to published. reject: pending only. remove: takes it down, restorable for 30 days, then deleted; repeat removals can auto-mute the author (the result's `authorAction`: muted or ban_suggested). suspend: hides it, reversibly. restore: brings back a rejected, suspended or removed one. Reporters are told: upheld by remove, dismissed by approve or restore. Formal cases close with neblla_community_cases; your own entry, no record: neblla_delete_community_entry. More: neblla_get_llms tools/moderate_community_entry

appId.description: The app's public ID, from neblla_list_apps.

env.description: "pro" (the published app, default) or "pre" (the private test copy).

reason.description: Required for reject, remove and suspend.

name: neblla_moderate_community_entry
title: Moderate a community entry
